artworks.title: Saturn
artworks.dimensions: sheet (circle, trimmed within platemark): 12 × 12 cm (4 3/4 × 4 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bearded man resting in a pastoral landscape with a medieval town in the background. The image shows a seated figure under a tree, holding a staff and gazing into the distance. The landscape is rich with trees and a flowing river. The background features a town with gothic architecture, multiple church spires, and a high-walled castle on a hill. The art style is detailed and intricate.

artworks.title: The Resurrection
artworks.description: The image shows a central person standing in a partially open tomb with a halo around their head. They are positioned upright with one knee bent, holding a staff with a cross and a banner attached. The person's facial features include long hair parted in the middle and a serene expression. They are dressed in flowing robes. Surrounding this central figure are four other individuals; two on either side of the tomb appear to be sleeping or have collapsed, wearing armor, and a third appears to be a winged angel leaning on the tomb. The angel is looking towards the central figure. Another figure at the bottom right, dressed in medieval attire, appears to be sleeping with one hand supporting his head. The background is blank, highlighting the figures in the foreground.

artworks.title: The Two Armies at the Battle of Ravenna
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical battle scene featuring armed soldiers on horseback and infantry with banners and pikes, suggesting a military engagement. The soldiers wear period-specific armor, and the scene shows a structured and organized setup for battle. The background includes a cityscape nestled among mountains, with a cannon and cannonballs in the foreground hinting at technological aspects of warfare. The use of line and shading creates depth and motion in the scene.

artworks.title: Virgin and Child Enthroned with Saint Anne
artworks.description: This image depicts a detailed architectural scene with two seated figures, surrounded by landscapes. The central part of the scene shows two figures seated on a throne-like structure within an archway. The figures are depicted in an interaction, with one holding an infant. They are dressed in flowing robes. The background features architectural details like arches and columns, with a checked pattern on the floor adding depth. On the sides, the scene extends to outdoor areas with pastoral elements and structures. Additional figures are engaged in various activities, such as shepherds among livestock. Angelic beings with open scrolls appear overhead on each side. Latin texts are inscribed within the scrolls and at the base of the throne.

artworks.title: Design for a Beaker and a Pax
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a symbolic heraldic scene with a religious undertone. The upper portion features a lion and a griffon holding a decorative cup or shield with intricate vine and leaf designs, enclosing two standing figures. Below this, there is an ornate architectural frame resembling a gothic or medieval niche housing a crowned figure seated with a child, holding a scepter or staff. The style and detail suggest a medieval or early Renaissance influence.

artworks.title: The Madonna and Child with Saint Anne
artworks.description: The image shows two women and a child seated on a platform. One woman holds the child. The child has a simplistic facial expression. The women have long hair and wear flowing garments. The background includes a town with gothic-style buildings, a river with ships, hills, figures engaged in activities, and lush foliage.

artworks.title: The Last Judgment [right]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene with figures inside rectangular openings. The image depicts a central haloed figure with a raised hand holding a flowered staff, seated with two other haloed figures standing on either side. Below them are several smaller figures emerging from rectangular openings in the ground. The drawing is done in a linear, black and white style illustrative of medieval religious art.

artworks.title: Christ's Entry into Jerusalem [left]
artworks.description: The image shows a medieval-style woodcut featuring four figures. The central figure is sitting on a donkey to the right, pointing forward with an extended arm. He has a long beard, long hair, and wears a robe, with a halo above his head. Two other figures behind him also have halos, looking serene, with similar hair and robe styles. They are standing. In front of them, another figure stands at a building entrance wearing a hat, robe, and a visible collar. A small tower or city gate is in the background on the right, with a tree slightly behind the standing figures. The image has a medieval aesthetic with simple lines and details.

artworks.title: Christ before Pilate
artworks.description: The image depicts four people, with their full figures shown. The central figure stands with arms crossed, wearing a long brown robe, a halo, long, dark hair and a beard. The central figure is flanked by two individuals wearing blue and green hats. The person to the left of the central figure is dressed in red and blue, holding a sword. To the right, a seated figure wearing blue tights and a red tunic holds a scepter. This person has dark hair and a beard, and wears a green hat with a pointed red conical section. The background consists of a simple pattern with a blue sky and neutral ground.

artworks.title: Saint James the Greater
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing upright. The person has a contemplative expression and a beard, with hair partly visible under a large hat with a shell design. They wear a long robe with a cloak, fastened at the shoulder with a clasp, and pointed shoes. The person holds a staff in their right hand and their left hand rests on their abdomen. A scroll with decorative text surrounds the figure, and the background is a plain, textured surface. The stone floor is visible beneath their feet.

artworks.title: Saint Peter
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length portrait of a standing figure. The person is facing forward, slightly turned to the side, with one foot stepping forward. They have curly hair and a beard, and their facial features are depicted with strong contours. The individual is wearing long, flowing garments and a cloak, holding an open book in one hand and a cross-shaped staff in the other. A halo surrounds their head, and there is a decorative, curled ribbon with text encircling the upper part of the figure. The person stands on a tiled floor, and the background is minimal, focusing on the figure and the ribbon.

artworks.title: Ornament with Wild Folk
artworks.description: The image shows detailed floral and fantastical creature motifs. It features large flowers intertwined with vine-like structures, along with imaginative creatures resembling mythical beings. The drawing has a classical style with fine lines and detailed shading, highlighting both the flowers and creatures in a harmonious composition.

artworks.title: Saint Benedict and the Monk Romanus
artworks.description: This is a painting of two monks and a goat-like creature in a forest. One monk is reading a book with a halo around his head, while the other is drawing water from a well. In the background, the goat-like creature imitates the monk drawing water. The setting is a forest with large trees and vegetation. The artwork features detailed linear outlines and flat colors, reminiscent of medieval manuscript illuminations or panel paintings. It is in the style of an anonymous medieval artist known for woodcut illustrations and detailed scenes with symbolic elements.

artworks.title: Pilate Washing His Hands
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures in an architectural setting. The figures are dressed in historical attire and gathered in a structured setting with intricate architectural details. One figure is seated beside a basin, surrounded by elaborate patterns and symbolic representations. The composition features detailed lines and patterns, emphasizing the clothing garments and expressions of the figures. The architectural elements include columns and arches adorned with ornamental designs. The drawing uses high-contrast black and white to highlight depth and intricacies.

artworks.title: The Entombment
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around a central figure who is lying on a platform. The drawing depicts a religious scene with several haloed figures surrounding an emaciated, reclining figure lying on a stone slab. The environment suggests a somber setting, with a barren landscape and an upright ladder visible in the background. The use of line work in the drawing is detailed, with emphasis on the folds of clothing and expressions of the figures, contributing to the solemn mood of the composition.

artworks.title: Lot and His Daughters
artworks.description: The image depicts a circular scene with three people dressed in medieval attire. In the foreground, two seated figures are shown from head to their legs. The man has a beard, wearing a multi-layered garment and a hat. The woman beside him has braided hair and a detailed dress. Standing beside them is a woman seen from head to toe, with her hair styled back and wearing an elaborate dress with ornamental sleeves, while holding a ladle over a basin. Jewelry is visible on the seated woman. The background shows a landscape with a body of water, a sailing ship, a burning city with tall towers and flames. An animal resembling a dog and a large decorated jug are seen in the foreground.

artworks.title: Lucretia
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a nude figure holding a sword with a dog beside them. The image depicts a central nude figure standing on a small platform or disk, holding a sword in one hand while clutching a draped piece of fabric in the other. The figure has flowing hair and appears to be gazing forward with a contemplative expression. To the left of the figure is a dog, sitting and gazing up towards the human figure. In the background, there is a town or castle-like structure, with a series of turrets and walls, perched on a landscape bordered by water. Above the scene, billowing clouds frame the character. The overall composition is framed in a diamond-shaped border.

artworks.title: Saint Mary Magdalene and Saint John the Evangelist
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length figures standing facing each other. Both figures have halos. The figure on the left is holding an open book. They wear long, flowing robes with folds and patterns. The figures have serene expressions; one with shorter, curly hair, and the other with longer, wavy hair. Surrounding them is an ornate architectural design with decorative elements. At the top, a dove with outspread wings appears between them. Below the figures is a line of text on a strip of decorative pattern. The background is plain, with the focus on the figures and their surroundings.

artworks.title: Saint Barbara
artworks.description: The image shows a figure standing with delicate facial features, a halo, and a head covering connected to a robe. The person is dressed in detailed flowing robes and is holding a sword and a book. The figure is surrounded by ornate architectural and floral details, including pillars and decorative patterns. At the top of the image, there is a circular inset showing two smaller figures in a gentle pose against a natural landscape.

artworks.title: Ornament with a Cupid, a Satyr,  and Grotesque Figures
artworks.description: The image features intricate lines and curving shapes forming a complex abstract composition. There is a symmetrical figure at the top with wings and a head resembling a human with dual horns. Below, a central figure blends human and animal features, such as a goat, surrounded by leafy embellishments resembling twisting vines. Among the organic forms are other abstract figures resembling fantastical beasts and cherub-like entities. The pattern suggests a tapestry of mythical figures and natural elements woven together in a dense, decorative artwork.

artworks.title: Upright Ornament with Two Sirens
artworks.description: The image features an intricate design with swirling lines and curved shapes forming a symmetrical pattern. It includes figures resembling cherubs and mythical creatures with wings, akin to classical sculpture and decorative motifs from ancient architectural friezes. The figures are intertwined with floral elements and scroll-like structures, creating a sense of movement and elegance. Organic shapes like leaves and vine-like tendrils are present, connecting to natural forms and classical adornments.

artworks.title: The Magdalen
artworks.artist: Master of the Die after Follower of Raphael
artworks.description: The image shows a female figure standing with a small ornate object in her left hand. She is turned slightly to her right, looking up at the object, with detailed facial features and long wavy hair. She wears a flowing garment and a circular headpiece, with bare feet visible. The background includes rolling hills, fortified buildings, and mountains under a cloudy sky.
